problem_statement: Fix the bugs in calculator.py so that test_calculator.py passes all tests.

Fix the bugs in auth/token.py and auth/validator.py so that tests/test_auth.py passes all tests. Specifically: 1. Ensure decode_payload handles unpadded base64 strings by adding required '=' padding characters. 2. Ensure validate_token correctly raises PermissionError('Token has expired') when the current_time has reached or passed the exp claim.
